mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_auth_audit_log ( trace_id, operator, operator_id, action, action_name, target_type, target_id, target_name, http_method, request_uri, client_ip, result, error_code, error_msg, cost_ms, created_time ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, #{operator}, #{operatorId}, #{action}, #{actionName}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{httpMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{clientIp}, #{result}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMsg}, #{costMs}, #{createdTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT action AS action, MAX(action_name) AS actionName, COUNT(1) AS total FROM sys_auth_audit_log WHERE action IS NOT NULL AND action <> '' GROUP BY action ORDER BY total DESC, action ASC
